candidates.description: This feature vector activates strongly in response to terms related to human sexuality, eroticism, and explicit anatomical or adult content.
This vector represents visual media, broadcasting, and entertainment formats.
This feature vector represents common descriptive adjectives and abstract nouns frequently used in Romance languages like Spanish and Portuguese.
This feature vector represents technology devices, brands, and digital platforms, particularly mobile phones and computing hardware.
These tokens represent common Romance language suffixes and noun/adverb endings, particularly in Portuguese, Spanish, and Italian.
This vector represents common Spanish and Portuguese interrogative and relative words, particularly variations of "que" and "como".
This feature vector activates on subwords, prefixes, and tokens starting with the letters "pro".
This feature vector represents the concept of colors and color-related root words across multiple languages.

This feature vector activates on terms related to growth, increase, or decline across multiple languages.
